V4-GI01.basis: Owner accepted gray-stone modern industrial refinement: graphite cabinet fronts, brushed gunmetal details and zoned lighting. R02 geometry retained.

BI01.basis: Accepted matte-black ceiling, medium-gray walls, graphite joinery, gray stone and gray-brown herringbone. All five layouts retained; all 300 AI slots replaced with newly generated and reviewed images.

AU01.basis: Owner accepts open island-side space; V4 returns 45cm windowward, V1/V4 adopt shared V4 seat/front-speaker depth, rack-mounted small complete surround proposals and front/rear overhead rows. Dimensions/acoustics pending.

TW01.basis: Owner adopts V4 full-height gray-stone TV feature without overhead cabinet in V1. Lower AV console and electrical service retained; AU01 positioning preserved. Model dimensions, stone fixing and service details pending.

VN01.basis: New public V2=oldV4, V4=oldV2(discontinued), V5=oldV3; V3 combines oldV4 base with exact V1 arc island, full-height double-sided glass and two outside stools. IR01.basis: All V0–V5 including historical V4/V5. Repair incomplete island service skins while preserving robot entries, equipment and layouts; restore double-sided sink liners; separate TV glass from casing to prevent z-fighting. Model repair only; joinery, ventilation and plumbing details await professional construction review.

sourceMethod: actual source geometry, perspective-correct textured offline render; no reflections, baked shadows or browser/GPU capture

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-interior-material-edit. IMAGE 1 is the existing photorealistic photograph to EDIT. IMAGE 2 is the same camera with the NEW approved materials and authoritative geometry. Preserve image 1 camera, architectural proportions, furniture, equipment, all shelves/contents and photographic realism; change material finishes to match image 2. Matte near-black ceiling and beams (#242628), medium neutral gray walls (#858986), deep-gray door bands where shown, graphite opaque joinery where image 2 shows it, brushed gunmetal frames. Keep existing gray stone ONLY on the marked feature panel/counter, and desaturated gray-brown herringbone wood where already present. Keep gray tile in wet/utility rooms. Preserve all existing real figurines and monitors, factory appliances and all fixed openings as image 1 and model 2 depict. White round speaker grilles are flat opaque NON-LUMINOUS discs. Do not change lighting locations or add decor, seating, lights, windows, equipment or stone. Do not brighten the black ceiling to white. Natural photographic soft shadows and restrained interior exposure; crisp realistic materials, NOT a CAD render. ONE landscape 1536x1024 image, no text. The photo is a previous finish version, so update every visible target surface according to model 2, including adjacent room ceilings seen through doors.
Service balcony. Preserve exact air-conditioner outdoor condensers, fan counts, washer/dryer units where visible, service sink and safety parapet/rail. Large white rectangles with black circles are mechanical equipment, not TVs, speakers or washing machines unless actually the depicted washer tower. No new equipment, wooden deck, timber floor, plants or closed glazing. Basin and mirror are separate, mirror is not a new door. Practical gray floor with subdued outdoor daylight. FINAL CHECK: every visible ceiling surface in EVERY visible room, including the living room viewed through study glazing, must be matte near-black. The entire home has NO skylights or roof openings. Any rectangular ceiling grille is an opaque dark ventilation grille, never blue sky or a glowing skylight. Preserve tiny functional devices and lower shelf finishes as modeled.

Input 1 is the CURRENT authoritative 3D model with repaired cabinet geometry. Input 2 is the previous AI view, used for photographic finish and lighting only. Match the EXACT camera, framing and every fixed object in input 1. Keep the photographic quality of input 2, not the crude CAD shading.
This repair fills missing island service-side panels, retaining real appliance access and narrow ventilation slots. The robot bay stays open at floor level, the wine refrigerator stays glass-fronted, and sinks are hollow bowls with visible inner walls and drains. Do not seal appliance entries or cover the sink. Preserve the existing countertop silhouette, real sink/IH cutouts, recessed knee space, stools, tall transparent double-sided glass cabinet if present, and all appliance positions. The TV has an intact flat dark screen without broken stripes.
Design must remain: matte BLACK ceilings and beams, medium gray mineral walls, graphite charcoal cabinet fronts, slim gunmetal frames, calm finely textured gray stone counters and TV feature walls, low-red gray-brown herringbone timber flooring. Existing kitchen and bathroom tiled floors stay tiled. Daylight plus soft neutral-warm interior light, believable photographic texture and shadows, no broad white ceilings. Tall glass displays remain see-through, not mirrored or solid walls. Preserve all existing partitions, windows, window sills, solid doors, shelves, furniture, and equipment. Do not invent windows, new doors, extra glass partitions, extra seating, appliances, shelving, LED patterns, ornaments, gold or dramatic marble. Ceiling round speaker grilles are speakers, not extra lamps.
Only apply what is visible in this camera. Other-room views may show a tiny distant public-space change; preserve all foreground furniture and architecture exactly. Do not add an island to a room where it is not visible. No collage, labels, text, watermark or dimensions. AI concept only, not a construction drawing. TV screen must be one clean black glass rectangle, no interference stripes or apparent torn edges. All freestanding rotation support, speaker boxes and subwoofer positions stay exactly as MODEL; do not simplify their count. Any island visible in background must follow repaired closed operating face, existing small floor-level robot opening, steel recessed basin. Preserve double desks behind glass. Opaque refrigerator is not a window. White ceiling circular speaker grilles are not bright downlights.
